name: callsRealMethodWhenMethodIsConcrete
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() returns a concrete (non-abstract) method and callRealMethod() succeeds
expected: Returns the result of invocation.callRealMethod() because the method is not abstract.

name: delegatesToGloballyConfiguredAnswerWhenMethodIsAbstract
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() returns an abstract method (Modifier.isAbstract is true)
expected: Delegates to GloballyConfiguredAnswer and returns its answer, avoiding an AbstractMethodError when calling real methods on abstract definitions.

name: propagatesThrowableWhenCallRealMethodThrowsException
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() is concrete and invocation.callRealMethod() throws a RuntimeException
expected: Propagates the thrown RuntimeException from callRealMethod() without catching or wrapping it.

name: propagatesCheckedExceptionWhenCallRealMethodThrowsCheckedException
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() is concrete and invocation.callRealMethod() throws a checked Exception (e.g., IOException)
expected: Propagates the checked Exception because the method signature declares 'throws Throwable'.

name: handlesNullInvocationSafely
expected: Throws NullPointerException when attempting to call invocation.getMethod().

name: handlesAbstractMethodWithGloballyConfiguredAnswerReturningNull
input: InvocationOnMock for an abstract method where GloballyConfiguredAnswer returns null
expected: Returns null as returned by the fallback GloballyConfiguredAnswer.

name: handlesInterfaceMethodWhichIsImplicitlyAbstract
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() is a method declared inside an interface (inherently abstract modifier)
expected: Recognizes the abstract modifier via Modifier.isAbstract and delegates to GloballyConfiguredAnswer.

name: handlesStaticAbstractMethodIfPossible
input: InvocationOnMock where getMethod() has abstract and static modifiers
expected: Treats it as abstract (Modifier.isAbstract is true) and delegates to GloballyConfiguredAnswer.

name: serializabilityContractMaintained
input: An instance of CallsRealMethods serialized and deserialized using standard Java serialization
expected: Deserializes successfully and retains identical behavior for answer(InvocationOnMock).

name: serialVersionUIDIsRespected
input: Checking serialVersionUID constant on CallsRealMethods class
expected: Equals 9057165148930624087L ensuring backward compatibility across serialization versions.
